name: WIOA In-School Youth Program
org: City of Sacramento Youth, Parks and Community Enrichment
what_you_do: You get career planning, workforce workshops, case management and paid work experience, such as internships, job shadowing or part-time work.
who_can_apply: Enrolled high school seniors who can get a work permit if under 18, are low income, and meet at least one barrier (for example disability, English learner, foster or homeless, justice-involved, parenting, or struggling academically).
pay_detail: Wage not posted on the page.
how_to_apply: Download the application from the page and email or hand it in, or pick up a paper copy at Belle Cooledge Community Center (9:30 am to 4:30 pm). WIOA@cityofsacramento.org
notes: Only for low-income students with at least one listed barrier. You can qualify as low-income through free or reduced lunch, SNAP or TANF, or a qualifying ZIP code. Work experience must start at age 18 or younger.
